title: SDK scenario
description: One scenario: a goal, ordered steps that call SDK operations (scenarios/OPERATIONS.md), the command lines that do the same, and what to expect. Rendered into a page and a code sample per language by tools/scenarios/render.py; executed in Python by tools/scenarios/run.py.

goal.description: One or two sentences: what the reader achieves.

docs.description: Site paths to read first, e.g. /docs/CORE/.

requires.description: hub: a running reference hub; repo: files from the checkout; full: the [full] Python extras.

args.description: Arguments by name. A value may be {"$file": "examples/x.json"} (read from the repository), {"$var": "name"} (a value saved by an earlier step), or {"$var": "name", "path": "status.id"}.

save.description: Variable name the result is stored under.

note.description: What this step shows, one or two sentences; rendered as a comment and as the step text on the page.

expect.description: Dotted path -> expected value, checked by the runner and printed by the samples. Paths may use [i] for arrays and a trailing .length.

seconds.description: wait only: seconds to sleep (the hub simulates time at --speed).

cli.description: Shell commands that do the same with the cookwala CLI or curl, from the repository root.

outcome.description: What the reader has at the end and what to do next.
